M/S Dolphin Tapes vs The State Of Telangana on 19 September,
2023
Hon'Ble Smt. Justice G. Anupama Chakravarthy

entities.text: Dolphin Tapes vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 to quash FIR No.439 of 2023 on the file of Mailardevpally Police Station, Cyberabad District,
registered for the offences under Sections 420, 406, 506, 468 and 120(b) of Indian Penal Code.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri S.Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent No.1 and perused the record.
3.

It is the specific contention of learned counsel for petitioners that there is a commercial transaction between the parties and even the de-facto complainant has obtained order from District Consumer Forum in C.C.No.170 of 2020 and inspite of it, a case has been registered against the petitioners.
4.

Since the punishment prescribed for the offences alleged against the petitioners is less than seven years, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the petitioners/ accused Nos.1 and 2 to appear before the Investigating Officer on or before 30.09.2023 between 02:00 p.m. and 04:00 p.m. and the Investigating Officer is directed to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C.
and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by furnishing information and documents as sought by him in concluding the investigation and petitioners shall not threaten or influence any one of the witnesses.

Petitioners are also permitted to make their oral submission before the Investigating Officer as well as they are permitted to file documents which shall be considered by the (2014) 8 SCC 273 Investigating Officer before filing any report before the concerned Magistrate.
5.
Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

G.ANUPAMA CHAKRAVARTHY, J Date:
